# Download Apps from the Amazon Appstore

Use the Amazon Appstore to browse for apps and download them to compatible devices.

Note: The Amazon Appstore is available on the following devices:

  * Fire TV
  * Fire Tablet


To download an app from the Amazon Appstore:

  1. Open the Amazon Appstore on your device.
  2. Search for the app you want to download and then select it. To check which of your devices support downloading the app, select View compatible devices.
  3. To start your download, select Get or the app's price.

To purchase an app, you need a default payment method on your Amazon account. You can also use an Amazon Gift Card

  4. When your download is complete, select Open to launch the app.

To find your Amazon Appstore apps, select My Apps.

Amazon will discontinue its app store for Android on August 20 this year. The company sent a notice to developers indicating that they will no longer be able to submit new apps to the store.

The company said on a support page that it will also discontinue its Coins digital currency, which could be used to purchase games and apps on the app store.

“Starting August 20, 2025, you will no longer have access to the Amazon Appstore on your Android device. We will also be discontinuing the Amazon Coins program on August 20, 2025,” the company said on a support page.

Amazon said that it will refund any coins that users hold as of August 20. The company added that only a small number of customers used the app store outside Amazon devices.

“We’ve decided to discontinue the Amazon Appstore on Android to focus our efforts on the Appstore experience on our own devices, as that’s where the overwhelming majority of our customers currently engage with it,” a company spokesperson said.

The company added that the app store will still be functional on its own devices, such as Fire TV and Fire Tablet.

Amazon has announced plans to shut down the store on August 20, 2025. The company says:

> Starting August 20, 2025, you will no longer have access to the Amazon Appstore on your Android device.
> 
> We will also be discontinuing the Amazon Coins program on August 20, 2025. As of Feb 20, 2025, Amazon Coins are no longer available for purchase.

As of today, “Amazon Coins” are also no longer available for purchase. Amazon Coins were a digital currency used for in-app purchases and games. If there are still Coins in your account as of August 20, they’ll be refunded (100 coins = $1).

It’s also important to note that this shutdown doesn’t just affect the store, but any apps that were downloaded from it. Many apps downloaded from the Amazon Appstore were dependant on having the store installed to work properly, and Amazon says that “any apps downloaded from the Amazon Appstore will not be guaranteed to operate on Android devices” following the shutdown. In a blog post for developers, Amazon says that it will continue to accept updates until August 20.

This shutdown will only affect users who have installed the Amazon Appstore on their devices manually. Fire Tablet, Fire TV, and other Amazon devices using the store will still continue to use it.

## Can you download the Amazon Appstore on an Android phone?

No. The official Amazon Appstore for Android mobile devices was discontinued on August 20, 2025. Amazon’s official Appstore release notes also state that developers can no longer submit or update apps for Android mobile devices through that service.

Older instructions that tell you to download an Amazon Appstore APK onto an ordinary Android phone are therefore obsolete or unsupported for the current service. A third-party APK mirror is not an official Amazon Appstore download source and should not be presented as one.

Device or platform  | Current Appstore situation  | Recommended path
--- | --- | ---
Amazon Fire tablet  | Supported device family using Fire OS  | Open the built-in Amazon Appstore and search for the app
Amazon Fire TV  | Supported device family; platform behavior can vary by model and operating system  | Open the device’s Appstore interface and search for the television app
Other Amazon device using a supported platform  | Availability depends on the device and platform  | Use the device’s built-in Appstore or an official marketplace listing
Ordinary Android phone  | Android-mobile Appstore service discontinued on August 20, 2025  | Do not use the old Amazon Appstore mobile installer as a current solution

The Android-mobile Appstore ended on August 20, 2025.
  * Do not label an APK mirror as official. Third-party downloads may be modified, outdated, unsafe, or incompatible with the target device.
  * Do not assume that sideloading bypasses compatibility. An APK can fail because of missing services, unsupported APIs, device architecture, licensing, or regional restrictions.
  * Do not use Fire TV ADB instructions for ordinary Appstore access. ADB is a developer and sideloading workflow documented separately from the built-in store.
  * Do not assume one menu sequence fits every device. Fire tablet and Fire TV labels vary by generation, software version, and marketplace.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I download the Amazon Appstore on an Android phone?

No. Amazon discontinued the Amazon Appstore for Android mobile devices on August 20, 2025. The current Appstore is primarily relevant on supported Amazon hardware and platforms such as Fire OS and Vega OS.

### How do I install an app from the Amazon Appstore?

On a supported Fire tablet or Fire TV device, open the preinstalled Amazon Appstore, search for the app, select its listing, and use the available install or obtain control. Labels vary by device generation, software version, and marketplace.

# Alexa for shopping

Designed to help you shop, the Alexa for Shopping experience is available to US customers in the Amazon Shopping app and on Amazon.com. To access Alexa while in the Amazon store, update your Amazon Shopping app and tap the Alexa icon in the navigation bar. Desktop users can find the Alexa icon at the top of their screen. Customers do not need a Prime membership or an Alexa-enabled device to use Alexa for Shopping.

## How customers use Alexa for shopping

Amazon brought Rufus and Alexa together to create one AI assistant that delivers a more personal, helpful shopping experience across a wide range of devices. In the Amazon store, this appears as Alexa for Shopping.

Alexa for Shopping helps customers make informed shopping decisions. Customers can use the AI assistant for the following:

  * Get product recommendations
  * Compare options
  * Get the latest product updates
  * Review historical product pricing
  * Set price alerts and Auto Buy
  * Understand product details and read what other customers say
  * Access current and past orders
  * Answer questions that aren't obviously related to shopping

Not all Alexa functionality is available in the Amazon store. For example, if customers ask Alexa to set a timer or turn on their living room lights with Alexa for shopping, they may be redirected to another Alexa experience (such as Alexa.com or the Alexa app) to help them carry out their request.
